verdict.line: You lose if Tahm Kench stacks three Tongue Lash hits onto you and chunks you with the Q(3)-stun before you commit; you win every all-in where you force the fight on your terms with Q(Decimate)'s blade edge and E(Apprehend) up.

brief.thesis: This matchup is genuinely even (54.2% Darius winrate over 288 games, versus 49.6% overall) because both champions want to fight, but on different timers: Tahm Kench's Q (Tongue Lash) applies An Acquired Taste stacks from range and stuns you at 3 stacks with E (Thick Skin) there to shield the follow-up, while you win the trade if you close with E (Apprehend)'s hook and finish before he can land the third poke. Whoever controls the engage range decides the fight.

tell.watch: Tahm's An Acquired Taste stack count

theirWindow.when: you're at 1-2 Acquired Taste stacks already
theirWindow.what: He only needs one more Q (Tongue Lash) land to stun you for a free follow-up combo, so don't walk into his max Q range (900) when you're already poked.

yourWindow.when: his E (Thick Skin) shield is down or spent
yourWindow.what: Thick Skin stores damage passively and converts it to a shield on a 3s cooldown active, but once he's just burned it reactively he has no buffer — this is when your E (Apprehend) hook into full combo does real damage instead of getting absorbed.

runes.keystoneWhy: The stacking adaptive force and healing on takedown directly offsets his sustained Tongue Lash poke and Thick Skin healing in extended trades; this is the higher-sample page at 53.8% over the alternative's 50%.

summoners.why: The dominant pick at 75.6% and winning 55.2%; Ghost closes the distance on Tahm before he can stack three Tongue Lash hits from range, which matters more here than Ignite's damage since this fight is about who lands first.

playing.title: Count stacks before you commit
playing.detail: An Acquired Taste caps at 3 and stuns you on the third Tongue Lash hit. Never engage sitting on 2 stacks already — back off and let them fall off first.

playing.title: Bait with W before all-in
playing.detail: W (Crippling Strike) slows on your next attack; use it to close the gap safely rather than walking straight into his 900-range Q poke.

playing.title: Hold E for the stun window
playing.detail: E (Apprehend) pulls him to you on a 26-16s cooldown depending on rank; save it for when he's already used Tongue Lash so he can't follow the hook with an immediate stun.

playing.title: Swing the Q edge, not the handle
playing.detail: OP.GG's own tip holds: Decimate's blade deals more damage than the handle, so position to clip him with the outer edge while closing distance, not the center.

playing.title: Track his E (Thick Skin) shield
playing.detail: Thick Skin stores damage passively and converts to a shield on a 3s cooldown active. If he's just used it reactively, he has no buffer — this is your window to commit full combo.

playing.title: Guillotine resets punish drawn-out fights
playing.detail: At rank 4-5, R (Noxian Guillotine) drops to a 6s cooldown and refreshes on a kill. In extended skirmishes this lets you threaten a second execute almost immediately.

playing.title: Don't fight below 3 stacks of Hemorrhage
playing.detail: Your passive enrages and grants massive AD at max Hemorrhage stacks; stack it with autos and Q before going for the kill combo rather than R'ing early.

brief.patchCaveat: All win rates, item paths, runes, and summoner picks above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning connecting them to specific ability timings and stack thresholds is my own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Tahm Kench’s (Q) while trying to close in on him. Keep your passive stacks up while dealing damage using the edge of [Q] when fighting him.
